simple.meaning: מֵרֹנֹתִי (Mêrônôthîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Meronothite , or inhabitant of some (otherwise unknown) Meronoth.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מֵרֹנֹתִי (H4824) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Chronicles 27:30, with occurrences in 1 Chronicles, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֵרֹנֹתִי (H4824) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מֵרֹנֹתִי (H4824) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מֵרֹנֹתִי (Mêrônôthîy) / H4824 is traced through 1 Chronicles 27:30, Nehemiah 3:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
